page.layout: One page of text with a running head at the top. Margin notes stand in the right margin. A narrow strip of the neighbouring page at the left edge is not transcribed.

main_text.p: subditorum quidem culpas per pastores per-cutit:: sed Pastorum vitia per semetipsum ferit. Ita populū percutiebat per Eli & filios eius, ipsum vero Eli, eiusque filios per semetipsum feriebat.

Pharaone iam cum curribus & equi-tibus suis in mari rubro submerso, & toto Israele indemni traiecto, factus est Moses ex Dei mandato, & consensu populi Iudaeorum Dux & Iudex. Hic ita-que licet{[} tria millia Gentes illius uno die per manus Levitarum occidi cura-verit,non legimus tamen,quòd vel gladium, vel linguam adversus eum strinxerit quispiam; & si aliquando murmura-ret populus, aut rebellis factus esset, acerbissimas semper dedit suae temerita-tis poenas;{t} vel enim incendio & conflagrationibus e coelo delapsis absorpti sunt, usq; aliquando ad 14. millia: vel plaga magna nimis consumpti, vel ab hiatu terrae aperientis os suum de-glutiebantur, vel Serpentibus ignitis percussi, vel lepra perfusi, ut Maria ip-sius Mosis germana soror, quae exinde (inquit Scriptura) {u} apparuit cadens ut nix, & ab-ea pene in instanti, usq; ad medium[Exod. 32. 27.†Num. 16. & 21.u Num. 12. 10.

page.notes: Left strip of the neighbouring page excluded. Reference mark before "licet" is a bracket-like sign, read as "[" and not certain. The abbreviation "usq;" is read with doubt in its mark. Printed "ab-ea" and "ip-sius" taken as hyphenated line-end breaks. Long s and f read as s throughout. Note "t" mark read as a dagger-like sign; "Num. 16." and "Num. 12." as printed.
